CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Noah and his sons? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Noah and his sons.
   B. Use Noah and his sons to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Noah and his sons with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Noah and his sons has no place in daily life.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Fall of Man.
   B. Say The Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of A hand writes on the wall? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of A hand writes on the wall with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use A hand writes on the wall to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing A hand writes on the wall.
   D. Say A hand writes on the wall has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Say Work has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.

7. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing King Solomon the wise ruler.
   B. Apply the teaching of King Solomon the wise ruler with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use King Solomon the wise ruler to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say King Solomon the wise ruler has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.
   C. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible as a Guide? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible as a Guide.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Bible as a Guide with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Bible as a Guide has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Bible as a Guide to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)
   A. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Family Unity.
   D. Say Family Unity has no place in daily life.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

12. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Sanctity of Life 3 5.4 Alcohol, drugs and Substance Abuse 3 5.5 Social Media 3 T and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Sanctity of Life and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Social Media 3 Total Number of Lessons 90 Note: The suggested number of lessons  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
